name: usage-hud
description: A small top-right HUD for context fill, auto-compaction, rate limits and cost; shows what each prompt sent along, steers compaction summaries, toasts each turn's cost and masks secrets

compactInstructions.title: Compaction instructions
compactInstructions.description: Added to every compaction's summary instructions (after any you type with /compact). Empty adds nothing.
compactInstructions.default: In the summary, keep: (1) every file created, edited or deleted, with its path and what changed; (2) the user's explicit requests, preferences and corrections, verbatim where short; (3) decisions made and why, including approaches rejected; (4) errors hit and how they were fixed; (5) open TODOs and the exact next step.

turnToast.title: Turn cost toast
turnToast.description: After each turn, a toast with what it cost, how long it took and the tokens it wrote.

maskSecrets.title: Mask secrets
maskSecrets.description: Mask known key and token formats out of every row before the session keeps it, so the model and later requests never see them.

promptContext.title: Prompt context card
promptContext.description: Under each prompt you type, a card listing what went to the model with it: @ files, CLAUDE.md, hook and plugin context, engine reminders, pasted images, with estimated tokens.
